_comment: EXPERIMENTAL flat-hand-on-paper method. Not used by the production app. Values marked 'assumed' are priors to be checked in the comparison pilot.

a4.label: A4
a4.source: ISO 216 A4. The tolerance is the commonly cited ISO 216 allowance of +/-2 mm for dimensions between 150 and 600 mm; verify against the standard before relying on it.

letter.label: US Letter (8.5 x 11 in)
letter.source: ANSI letter size, 8.5 x 11 in. Tolerance assumed equal to the A4 allowance.
